June 18th: Landmarks in southwest Iceland

- <span style="color:NavajoWhite">Thingvellir is the site of Iceland's parliament from the 10th the 18th century</span>
- <span style="color:MediumAquaMarine">Geysir, a.k.a. The *Great Geysir*, is a hot spring and geothermal area</span>
- <span style="color:LightPink">Gullfoss, a.k.a. *Golden Falls*, is a huge two-tiered waterfall</span>

:::

::: {focus-on="cr-route" pan-to="370%,-260%" scale-by="16"}

- <span style="color:PaleTurquoise">National Museum of Iceland</span>

- <span style="color:PaleTurquoise">Nautholsvik beach</span>
- <span style="color:PaleTurquoise">Some interesting stores we missed on day 1</span>

- <span style="color:LightSkyBlue">Barnafoss and Hraunfossar waterfalls</span>

- <span style="color:LightPink">Rauðisandur, the red sand beaches</span>

June 24th: Happy birthday, Alex! A special day to celebrate

- <span style="color:YellowGreen">Horse riding at Dalahestar</span>
- <span style="color:DarkOrange">Drive back down past Reykjavik to some geothermal sites around the Reykjanes</span>

June 25th: More of the Reykjanes

- <span style="color:Green">Very long hike along Fagradalsfjall volcano</span>
- Visit to the Bridge Between Continents, which spans a fissure between the Eurasian and North American tectonic plates
- <span style="color:PaleTurquoise">Drive back to Reykjavik to arrive at Downtown Reykjavik Apartments</span>
